answer: Bind incoming cohorts through pairwise key swaps around a ring so accounts prove separate live kernel control before activation. Entrants post stakes in escrow, record a beacon commit with a signed hash and audit proof across >=4 epochs, and finish exchange steps during heavy gale bursts.
